subject: Validation results and quick advocacy check-in
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@atlasretail.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 29 Apr 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Quick validation wrap + 10-min quote call?

Hi Liam —

Huge thanks to you and Aisha for running the pilot with us. We reviewed the final numbers on our side and wanted to share a short validation recap and one quick ask. Attached is a one-page snapshot with the raw metrics. High-level highlights across your test traffic (two-week pilot, ~38k requests):

- Average generation latency: 480ms -> 210ms (56% reduction)
- Cost per 1k tokens (serving): down 3.1x with batching + KV caching
- Throughput at 95th percentile: +2.4x vs baseline infra
- Search-to-checkout conversion uplift on test cohort: +4.6% (A/B)

Those moves translated into an estimated ~$18k/month operational saving at your current volumes and materially better page responsiveness for higher-intent flows.

If you're open, we'd love a very short (10–15 minute) call next week to capture a 1–2 line quote we can include in a brief customer highlight and to confirm a single-sentence attribution. No heavy marketing ask — just permission to publish a short blurb and a quick quote (you can approve the exact wording).

Availability I can offer: Tue 05/04 10:00–10:30 PT, Wed 05/05 14:00–14:30 PT, or Thu 05/06 09:00–09:20 PT. If those don't work, tell me a slot and we'll adapt.

Thanks again — we were really pleased with the results and excited about what you can ship next quarter.

Best,
Grace
Director, Customer Success
Redwood Inference

- The $18k/month estimate checks out when including peak-hour traffic.

Happy to provide a short quote. Draft (feel free to edit):
"Redwood's inference stack reduced our response times and cut serving costs significantly, helping us accelerate high-intent flows and increase conversions." — Liam O'Connor, Director of Product, Atlas Retail

We can do a 10-minute call tomorrow 05/04 at 10:00 PT to finalize wording. For publishing, we'd like the quote attributed to title + company and for any case study to be shared for approval before publication.
